facts.text: In 1982, the Park Cities Historical Society was founded to preserve the community's heritage.
The Society supports archives at the University Park Library, landmarking, scholarships for HPISD seniors, and a Distinguished Chair for History at Highland Park High School.
A video project records oral histories of long‑standing residents, showcasing how architecture and people shaped Park Cities.
Park Cities originated as two planned upscale communities, Highland Park founded in 1913 and University Park incorporated in 1924, surrounded by Dallas.
The area spans roughly 5.93 square miles, remaining fully incorporated without annexation gaps, and sits just four miles north of downtown Dallas.
Highland Park Village, opened in 1931, was the nation’s first planned outdoor shopping center, a landmark of the Park Cities.
